name: EfficientDet-Lite0 (int8)
architecture: EfficientNet-Lite0 backbone + BiFPN + class/box heads (one-stage, anchor-based); int8 post-training quantised TFLite

vocabulary.labels_from: labels.txt packed in the TFLite metadata

paper: M. Tan, R. Pang, Q. V. Le, EfficientDet: Scalable and Efficient Object Detection, CVPR 2020, arXiv:1911.09070

hardware.notes: Runs on phone CPUs; 63-113 ms per frame measured in headless Chromium on a 4-core x86 CPU (docs/benchmarks/browser_bench.json).

reported.source: TensorFlow Lite Model Maker object detection guide (EfficientDet-Lite table)

input.source: TFLite input tensor shape [1, 320, 320, 3] (read with the tflite flatbuffer schema)

postprocess.source: MediaPipe object_detector_options.proto defaults (min_suppression_threshold=0.3, multiclass_nms=false); the model has no in-model NMS

limitations: 320x320 input: objects below ~20 px after resizing are rarely found
Fixed class-agnostic NMS at IoU 0.3 inside MediaPipe (not configurable through the Tasks API)
